--values:values `file`, repeatable, merged in order over the release's values; - reads stdin
--reset-values:do not send the release's values; send only the --values files and the values rancher-cli adds
--force:Helm replaces the release's resources instead of patching them; not with --take-ownership
--take-ownership:Helm takes ownership of existing resources; Rancher also sends --server-side=true and --force-conflicts
--cleanup-on-fail:Helm deletes the resources this upgrade created when it fails
--history-max:maximum number of revisions Helm keeps for the release, 1 to 100 (Rancher uses 5 when it is omitted)
--helm-wait:Helm waits for the chart's resources (default true; --helm-wait=false sends false)
--helm-timeout:Helm `timeout` for each step, 1s to 15m (default 10m)
--no-hooks:do not run the chart's hooks
--disable-openapi-validation:do not validate the rendered resources against the OpenAPI schema
--description:release `description`
--system-default-registry:registry `host` to send at values.global.cattle.systemDefaultRegistry and values.global.systemDefaultRegistry
--no-system-default-registry:send neither registry value, also when the release's values or a values file set one
--wait:wait until Helm's run finishes and report how it ended
--timeout:wait `timeout`, e.g. 10m (default 55m, at most 55m; starts the wait)
--help:show help
--debug:print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
